mainEntity.name: How much does film production cost in Egypt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Film production costs in Egypt vary based on scope. Commercial ads start from $5,000, documentaries from $10,000, and full TV productions from $50,000. Competitive pricing is available across all budgets.

mainEntity.name: How long does video production take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Production timelines depend on the project type. A commercial ad typically takes 2-4 weeks, a documentary 4-12 weeks, and a corporate video 1-3 weeks. We provide detailed timelines during the pre-production phase.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer production services outside Egypt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — services are available across MENA including Egypt, Dubai, and Jeddah, with on-ground production in Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, and other MENA countries.

mainEntity.name: What types of video production do you specialize in?

acceptedAnswer.text: We specialize in commercial advertising, documentary production, corporate content, TV shows, event coverage, podcast production, post-production, and CGI/motion graphics.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle the full production cycle?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — the complete production cycle from concept development and scripting through filming, post-production, and final delivery including localization and dubbing.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with international clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We work with international brands, broadcasters, and institutions worldwide. Our multilingual team handles projects in Arabic, English, French, and other languages.

mainEntity.name: Can you manage permits, locations, casting, crew, and equipment for productions in Egypt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Global Untold Story can manage the production process in Egypt, including location scouting, production planning, casting coordination, crew, equipment, logistics, permits, filming, and post-production. We can support both local and international productions from pre-production through final delivery.
